parsed.diagnosis: FDIR residual threshold 0.3 mNm isolates mildly degraded wheels (severity 0.2 friction ~0.4 mNm, residuals ~4.5-5.1e-04 Nm) that are still controllable. With single-isolation limit, this leaves a more degraded second wheel in use on 3 wheels, causing attitude_loss/saturation that 4-wheel control without isolation tolerates.
parsed.rationale: Raise absolute residual threshold from 0.30 to 0.60 mNm to sit between lowest-tier friction (0.2*2=0.4 mNm) and next tier (0.35*2=0.7 mNm). This permanently filters 0.2-friction false isolations while larger friction and torque-derate/dead wheels still exceed threshold when commanded torque is large, preserving needed isolations with only added delay.
parsed.why_no_regressions: Mild single faults do not need isolation to stay clean. Severe/dead faults scale with command and still exceed 0.6 mNm, so clean runs relying on isolation still isolate. No change to SAFE, power, or watchdog logic.
